program.name: Bodyweight Arm Strength
program.subject: Arms
program.blurb: Arms with no gear: dips, close push-ups and floor curls in sets, then a circuit.
program.about: Arms built with nothing but your own weight. One day is straight sets of dips, close push-ups and bodyweight curls; the other is a circuit of the same, round after round. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Bodyweight arm sets / arm circuit, no gear
